title: Pop Kill: Big Candy #2
desc: Jon and Dina survive an attack that should have killed them, but escaping the wreckage is only the beginning. As Big Candy's shadowy operatives tighten the noose, the pair uncover clues that send them across the globe in pursuit of the truth. The wrappers are off, the gloves are off, and one thing's for certain: the only thing sweeter than candy is revenge. Jimmy Palmiotti and Dave Johnson deliver another irresistible helping of razor-sharp satire, explosive action, and enough candy-coated chaos to satisfy even the sweetest tooth in this can't-miss second issue!
